commands.name: viaversion-list
commands.label: Player versions
commands.description: Shows lists of the versions from logged in players.

commands.name: viaversion-player
commands.label: Player connection info
commands.description: Shows connection information about one or all players.

commands.name: viaversion-pps
commands.label: Packets per second
commands.description: Shows the packets per second of online players.

commands.name: viaversion-dump
commands.label: Dump
commands.description: Dump information about your platform implementation, this is helpful if you report bugs.

commands.name: viaversion-debug-clear
commands.label: Clear debug packets
commands.description: Clears the packet types to log in debug mode.

commands.name: viaversion-debug-pre
commands.label: Toggle pre-transform logging
commands.description: Toggles logging of packets before they are transformed.

commands.name: viaversion-debug-post
commands.label: Toggle post-transform logging
commands.description: Toggles logging of packets after they are transformed.

commands.name: viaversion-debug-add
commands.label: Add debug packet
commands.description: Adds a packet type to debug logging.

commands.name: viaversion-debug-remove
commands.label: Remove debug packet
commands.description: Removes a packet type from debug logging.

commands.name: viaversion-displayleaks
commands.label: Leak detector level
commands.description: Try to hunt memory leaks! Shows or sets the leak detector level.

commands.name: viaversion-autoteam
commands.label: Toggle auto team
commands.description: Toggle automatically teaming to prevent colliding.

commands.name: viaversion-reload
commands.label: Reload config
commands.description: Reload the config from the disk.
